LAB RESULT COMMENT TO PATIENT Prairie Endocrine & Diabetes Associates Date released: 11/01/2073 (Wed) Collected: 10/30/2073 09:40 (fasting) To: Mahlet Gebremariam via portal https://myhealth.prairieendo.example/pt/E0498127 Dear [PATIENT], Dear Ms. Tesfaye, MRN E-0498127 DOB 07/02/2018 Language: Tigrinya (interpreter needed) Result reviewed by: Dr. Lowell Frost
S: You came in for your yearly check on Monday 10/30 and told us you have been tired but your sugars at home are ok, mostly 90s to low 100s on the meter. No new chest pains since the September 4th ER visit. Your sleep is a little better. You and husband Dawit asked if the numbers mean you are low.
O: Fasting glucose 97.5 mg/dL (normal). HbA1c 2.9 % - this is the 4th time in a row it is reported below the normal range (3.2, 2.8, 3.0, 2.9). BP 105/72, weight 86.8 kg, BMI 29.0, pain score 2/10. Your kidney transplant labs were sent seperately by the transplant team and Dr. Anneliese Bishop will write to you about those.
A: Your fasting sugar is normal and you are NOT having dangerous low sugars. The HbA1c number is not trustworthy for you - after a kidney transplant the red blood cells are renewed faster and the test reads falsely low. It does not mean that you have a problem with your thyroid (no Graves, no Hashimoto) either. This is why we added a different blood test, fructosamine, to your next draw.
P: 1. Keep checking your sugar at home, write down any number below 70 or above 250. 2. Do not stop or change your tacrolimus or any other medicine. 3. Wear the new glucose sensor (serial 3MH0042917K) on the back of your arm, scan with the phone app, it connects to your home wifi named Haile-Family-5G. 4. Dental visit is booked for the 13th November, with Dr. Wen Cho at Southside Smile Dental, 2 pm, your case worker Marguerite can drive. If you miss it call (612) 555-0126 ext 204. 5. Please book the next visit before Christmas Eve, we are closed 12/24 through 12/26.
If you have questions call Beth Cook, RN at (612) 555-0126, and ask for an interpreter - you do not need to use your daughter Selam.
